about.description: Bond perpetual on Ostium Labs priced off the iShares iBoxx $ High Yield Corporate Bond ETF (HYG), a high-yield corporate bond ETF, with pricing referencing Stork / QUODD. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDC on Arbitrum. Users get duration-and-credit exposure without holding ETF shares, accrued coupons, or distribution rights.
